verdict.rationale: Pulumi's GitHub states it provisions resources on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes and 300+ providers, and the docs say every language supports the full surface area of all Pulumi Registry providers. Hands-on users report managing GCP, AWS, DigitalOcean and Kubernetes with it. One older community report says Azure provider support lagged, which is a caveat rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of SaaS (non-cloud) provider coverage, in-depth Registry/provider-catalog documentation, and current evidence that provider updates keep pace with upstream clouds.
